entityListLabel: products, customers, orders, categories, or reviews in an online shop
outOfScopeDescription: anything unrelated to searching/filtering products, customers, orders, categories, or reviews in an online shop - e.g. general knowledge, cooking, weather, small talk

product.description: Products for sale in the shop

in_stock.description: whether the product is currently in stock

added_at.description: when the product was added to the catalog

placed_by_me.description: the caller's own orders - 'my orders', 'orders I placed', no other person involved

status.description: the order's status, e.g. pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled

category.description: Product categories in the shop's catalog

product_count.description: how many products belong to the category

written_by_me.description: the caller's own reviews - 'my reviews', 'reviews I wrote', no other person involved

verified_purchase.description: whether the review is from a verified purchase
